question: Evaluate $\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\2&3&4\\4&9&16\end{vmatrix}$ by using suitable column operations.
explanation:
Column operations
Apply $C_2\to C_2-C_1$ and $C_3\to C_3-C_1$. These operations do not change the determinant. Thus, $$\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\2&3&4\\4&9&16\end{vmatrix}=\begin{vmatrix}1&0&0\\2&1&2\\4&5&12\end{vmatrix}$$
Expansion along the first row
Since the first row now contains two zeros, $$\begin{vmatrix}1&0&0\\2&1&2\\4&5&12\end{vmatrix}=1\begin{vmatrix}1&2\\5&12\end{vmatrix}$$
Evaluation of the remaining determinant
Therefore, $$1[(1)(12)-(2)(5)]=12-10=2$$
Hence, the value of the given determinant is $2$.
